columns.name: Game name as we write it (the App Store name without the tagline).
columns.studio: Developer shown on the App Store.
columns.released: First release date on the US App Store.
columns.ios_rating: Average rating on the US App Store, exact to two decimals.
columns.ios_ratings: Number of ratings on the US App Store.
columns.android_rating: Average rating on the US Google Play store.
columns.android_ratings: Number of ratings on the US Google Play store.
columns.android_downloads: Download range shown by Google Play, for example 10M+. Blank when we could not match the game to a Google Play page.
columns.price_ios: Price on the US App Store: Free, a dollar price, Free to try, Apple Arcade or Netflix membership.
columns.price_android: Price on the US Google Play store.
columns.android_ads: Whether the Google Play page shows the "Contains ads" label.
columns.android_iap: Whether the Google Play page shows the "In-app purchases" label.
columns.ios_size_mb: Download size on iPhone from Apple's iTunes Search API.
columns.ios_languages: Number of languages listed on the App Store.
columns.ios_version: Latest version number on the App Store.
columns.ios_last_update: Date of the latest App Store update.
columns.age_rating: Age rating on the US App Store.
columns.read_on: Most recent date we read this game's store pages.
columns.boltshorts_page: This game's page on Boltshorts, with every number and how it compares.
columns.boltshorts_lists: Boltshorts lists that rank this game.
columns.app_store_id: Numeric App Store id. It never changes, so it is the key to join versions and other datasets.
columns.genres: Every App Store category of the game, main one first, separated by semicolons.
columns.ios_min_version: Oldest iOS version the current App Store build supports.
columns.ipad: Whether the App Store lists iPad among the supported devices.
columns.ios_advisories: Content descriptors behind the App Store age rating, for example "Loot Boxes" or "Infrequent/Mild Simulated Gambling".
columns.android_developer: Developer name shown on Google Play.
columns.android_released: Release date shown on Google Play.
columns.android_last_update: Date of the latest update shown on Google Play.
columns.android_iap_range: Price range per item that Google Play shows, for example "$0.99 - $99.99 per item".
columns.android_editors_choice: Whether the Google Play page shows the Editors' Choice badge.
columns.chart_date: Date of the App Store top charts in chart_positions.
columns.chart_positions: Positions in the US App Store top 100 charts for iPhone on chart_date, as chart/category/rank, separated by semicolons. Categories are App Store game genres; "Games" is the chart of all games.
columns.source_set: "boltshorts-lists" for a game on one of our lists, "app-store-charts" for a game that was in a US App Store top chart for games when we read them.
